established_by: Adjacent-page supplier GSTINs, plus six scans read by eye. Of the 27 adjacent page pairs, 19 name two different GSTINs that each pass their check digit, so neither page of those pairs can be a continuation of the other — a fact in the transcription, independent of any reading of the packet. That leaves 8 pairs where one bill spanning two pages is even possible, and each is resolved below. The boundaries here are therefore closer to proven than inferred; the kind labels are weaker (see kind_confidence).

ambiguous_pairs_resolved.15-16, 16-17: No supplier GSTIN on any of the three. Page 15 read from the scan: a Porter trip-detail screenshot showing CGST 0.00 and SGST 0.00. Pages 16 and 17 carry the same 'Trip details' header block.

ambiguous_pairs_resolved.21-22, 22-23: Page 22's supplier GSTIN fails its check digit as scanned (32ABSP14532L1ZG, the read the pipeline now repairs), so the adjacency test cannot speak. Page 22 read from the scan: Alleppey Techno Care, marked 'Page 1 of 1'.

kind_confidence: Weaker than the boundaries, and the weakness is one-directional: pages 16, 17 and 26 are labelled from their OCR headers alone. A wrong 'non_invoice' here would flatter the pipeline, since the page would be scored as correctly skipped.
